name: Matthews
bio: The name Matthews appears for the owner of a camp where horses were stolen in February 1884, for a stock inspector in town in October 1884, and for the man Tuttle defeated for sheriff at Glendive in November 1886.

moments.label: Lost the Glendive sheriff race to Tuttle
